profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm passionate about building high-performance systems that empower experimentation, enable data-driven decisions, and do social good at scale. With 5+ years of experience at Meta, I’ve led efforts to optimize ML experimentation frameworks, reduce computation costs, and improve system reliability — saving millions in resources while accelerating innovation. From fine-tuning large-scale data pipelines for GenAI to improving fairness and privacy in Ads experimentation, I thrive at the intersection of algorithms, infrastructure, and impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and optimized experimentation framework for LLM and RAG, improving model benchmarking, developer velocity, and large-scale pipeline efficiency.

Drove major performance and cost improvements, cutting metrics query latency by ~50%, reducing experimentation pipeline costs by ~20%, and saving ~$2M via system-wide CPU optimizations.

Ensured experimentation integrity by developing privacy-aware analytics, blocking misconfigurations with potential ~$33M impact, and revamping Ads segmentation to eliminate carryover bias.
positions.insights: Skills: Presto · Python (Programming Language) · Project Planning · Project Implementation · PHP · C++ · Apache Spark · Data Analysis · Software Design · Engineering · Optimizing Performance · Scalability · SQL · Data Pipelines · React.js · Microservices · Apache Thrift · Git · Mercurial · Agile Methodologies
